items.title: MrBeast: 'GTA 5 vs GTA 6 me'
items.note: On GTA 6 launch eve, MrBeast turned the 13-year graphics jump into a glow-up meme, and everyone started posting their own then-vs-now pics.
items.read: With Grand Theft Auto VI arriving on 19 November, 13 years after GTA V, MrBeast posted two photos side by side: his fresh-faced 2013 self as 'GTA 5' and his 2026 look as 'GTA 6'. X's trend summary says it set off a wave of people comparing old and new photos, cars and beach shots in the style of the two games.

items.title: He booked a hotel for a week to play GTA 6
items.note: A fan checked into a hotel for launch week so nobody could bother him, and his wife thinks he's 'crazy or unfaithful'.
items.read: A Reddit user in r/GTA6unmoderated posted that he'd rented a hotel room for the whole GTA 6 launch week so nobody could interrupt him, adding that his wife thinks he's crazy and/or unfaithful. Internet Hall of Fame reposted it on X, where it blew up. Coverage notes there's no receipt, so treat it as a very committed story, and the comments are split between salutes and divorce-lawyer jokes.

items.title: GTA 6 is out, so the 'before GTA 6' meme is retired
items.note: Thirteen years of 'we got X before GTA 6' jokes end today, and the internet is holding a funeral for the meme.
items.read: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time, so fans joked about 'flying to New Zealand' to play first, and Tourism New Zealand joined in on Instagram. Others posted farewells to the 'before GTA 6' format, including a gravestone reading 'GTA VI memes and jokes'. Reddit countdown posts hit 100% with 'You made it!'. #GTA6 is trending worldwide and in Saudi Arabia on X today.

items.title: Saudi X: 'GTA landed here before everyone 😎'
items.note: Saudi creators are in full GTA 6 mode, with Abu Luka bragging the game reached him before the rest of the world.
items.read: #GTA6 and #GTAVI are both on Saudi Arabia's X trend list today. Among the Arabic launch posts, @abuluka8's video, captioned 'قراند نزل عندنا قبل الكل' ('GTA dropped here before everyone'), is one of the most-viewed. Other Saudi posters joked that 'before Corona' has been replaced by 'before GTA'.

items.title: The stork that's aura farming on a pole
items.note: A stork poses so dramatically on a pole that X crowned it 'aura farming to the max'.
items.read: A 13-second clip shared by @sciencegirl shows a stork balancing theatrically against a blue sky, with power lines nearby. X's trend summary says replies called it the main character of the moment, an overlord glaring at peasants, and 'Behold, the Bird'.

items.title: 'POV: you married a woman full of ideas'
items.note: Layi Wasabi's skit about a wife who keeps derailing her husband with ideas has married couples laughing and arguing in the quotes.
items.read: Nigerian comedian Layi Wasabi plays a husband trying to focus while his wife keeps interrupting with new suggestions. X's summary says lines like 'charity seeking charity' got quoted everywhere, and viewers argued about whether it's how real couples talk.

items.title: 'Talk To Me Doja': the anime cheek-cup sway
items.note: TikTok is copying a nervous, cheek-cupping anime dance to sped-up Doja Cat, often right next to the original clip.
items.read: It started on 7 November, when TikToker @lovingbalanci paired a scene from Yamada-Kun and the Seven Witches with Doja Cat's 'Like That'. In the scene, Urara does a flustered little dance while confirming a date. People now recreate the sway as closely as they can, usually side by side with the anime, with 'talk to me Doja' written on screen.

items.title: 'How Pinterest sees me' collages
items.note: People are searching 'character, animal, lyric, weather' on Pinterest and posting whatever the algorithm thinks they are.
items.read: The format is simple. Search 'character', 'animal', 'lyric' and 'weather' on Pinterest, screenshot your top personalised result for each, and post the four as 'how Pinterest sees me'. X's trend summary says results range from anime angels and fluffy foxes to Radiohead lyrics and stormy wildflower fields, and people are surprised by how accurate it feels.

items.title: Juthoor Market, The Cultural House
items.note: Riyadh debut of the local farmers-and-makers market opens today, Nov 19, for ten days.
items.read: Juthoor Market comes to Riyadh for the first time, at The Cultural House (Altaawun Public Library) in Al Taawun. Expect stalls from local farmers and homegrown brands, restaurants and cafés, live music, hands-on workshops and kids' activities. Tickets are on Webook.
facts: The Cultural House, King Salman Oasis, Al Taawun
items.mapQuery: The Cultural House Altaawun Public Library Riyadh

items.title: Boulevard World: 4 new country zones
items.note: Uzbekistan, Netherlands, Portugal and Yemen zones just opened at Riyadh Season's Boulevard World.
items.read: Boulevard World opened four new zones earlier this week. Uzbekistan brings Silk Road architecture and suzani patterns, the Netherlands has windmills, canals and tulips, Portugal recreates Lisbon's azulejo tiles and fado, and Yemen showcases its traditional art and architecture.

items.title: Wonder Garden, Boulevard City
items.note: Riyadh Season's flower-filled family zone returns Sunday, Nov 22, after a year-long break.
items.read: Wonder Garden is back for Riyadh Season, opening for the first time in Boulevard City. Experiences spotted so far include a Flower Garden, Ms. Rachel's World, Slimy Squishy Lab, Strange Creatures Factory and The Last Signal. Ms. Rachel's World tickets are already on sale.

items.title: Aroos We Arisa, Bakr Al-Sheddi Theatre
items.note: Egyptian-style married-life comedy opens tomorrow, Nov 20, at Boulevard City.
items.read: Aroos We Arisa is a social comedy set in Old Maadi that follows a newlywed couple after the honeymoon ends. It's one of five Riyadh Season shows on sale now, alongside the family musical The Toy Shop and the Al Dirah Comedy Nights stand-up.
items.mapQuery: Bakr Al-Sheddi Theatre Boulevard City Riyadh

items.title: West Mebon Temple, Angkor
items.note: Reopened to visitors Nov 18 after a 14-year, ~$12M Cambodia-France restoration.
items.read: West Mebon sits on an island in the middle of the West Baray reservoir in Angkor and dates to the mid-11th century. King Norodom Sihamoni and President Emmanuel Macron marked the end of the restoration on Nov 16, and the temple reopened two days later.

items.title: Chiang Mai Tram by Lannatique
items.note: Thailand's first fully electric tourist tram launched Nov 18, linking 15 Chiang Mai sights.
items.read: The new tram runs a 15.8km route past Tha Phae Gate, Warorot Market, Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh. Trams have PM2.5 air filtration, real-time tracking and digital guides, and the operator says leftover revenue goes to local community projects.

items.title: Rob Run
items.note: Free cops-vs-robbers sandbox on Steam went viral as PC players wait for GTA VI.
items.read: Rob Run launched in early access on Nov 4 and peaked at 140,440 concurrent Steam players within days, also topping 71,000 Twitch viewers. Every cop and robber is a real player, with shared worlds of up to 5,000. User reviews are mixed over generative-AI art, server issues and performance.

items.title: BAPE x Billie Eilish
items.note: Orange-camo collab sold out its Camo Shark hoodie in Japan on launch morning.
items.read: BAPE's 13-piece Billie Eilish collection dropped Nov 14 in Japan and on Complex in the US. By Saturday morning in Tokyo, the varsity jacket, Camo Shark hoodie, Baby Milo tee, rhinestone belt and socks showed sold out on BAPE Japan's online store.

items.title: NOCTA x Nike Air Modmax
items.note: Drake's new NOCTA sneaker sold out in most sizes on Nike.com after its Nov 17 drop.
items.read: The 'Pink Spell and Amarillo' Air Modmax is the third new silhouette from Drake's NOCTA and Nike. It has six individually tuned Air units and a two-tone pink upper. More sizes were still listed on NOCTA.com, and resale asks are above retail.

items.title: Netflix: The Body & Black Doves S2
items.note: The Body is the week's biggest new series, and Black Doves season 2 is picking up in week two.
items.read: In the Netflix Top 10 for the week ending Nov 15, The Body debuted as the biggest new series with 5.1M views and is still climbing the daily charts. Black Doves season 2 nearly doubled its views in week two. Jessica Chastain's Heartland topped the English film list with 7.3M views.

items.title: Claude climbs the App Store charts
items.note: Anthropic's Claude hit #1 on iPhone Top Free in 5 new countries this week.
items.read: AppWinners' weekly charts for Nov 16 to 22 show Claude by Anthropic at #1 on iPhone Top Free in 21 countries, five of them for the first time. ChatGPT still leads in 48 countries and Meta AI in 16. The week isn't over, so the numbers update daily.

items.title: Lemonada Gardens
items.note: A leafy Lebanese garden restaurant in Al Sulaymaniyah, built around a sacred fig tree.
items.read: Arab News (17 Nov 2026) describes Lemonada Gardens, part of the Hawa Al-Riyadh Hotel Apartments, as a garden-like Lebanese restaurant with a sacred fig tree at the centre of its outdoor seating. It opened in 2023. The reviewer praised the mixed grill, especially the tender lamb shish, and the Arabic-classics playlist, and put dinner at about SR100–150 a person. It tends to fill up after 10 p.m., especially on weekends. The restaurant's own site lists hours as 2 p.m. to 3 a.m. (to 4 a.m. Thursday and Friday).
facts: 2 PM–3 AM Sat–Wed; 2 PM–4 AM Thu–Fri (official site)
About SR100–150 per person for dinner (Arab News)

items.title: Mahsan (مهسان)
items.note: An Anatolian Turkish restaurant in An Nada, from a chef who collected village recipes across Anatolia.
items.read: Arab News (11 Sep 2026) says Mahsan opened in mid-June in Shorofat plaza in An Nada. Chef Omur Akkor travelled village to village in Anatolia to learn the flavours now served in Riyadh; he also has restaurants at Istanbul and Antalya airports. The reviewer strongly recommended the Ali Nazik and Anatolian spiced potatoes, called the dolma a must-try, and found the manti and stuffed leaves more mixed, while still calling it good value.
facts: 7089 Abi Bakr As Siddiq Rd, An Nada 13317 (Exa listing)
Ali Nazik, dolma, Anatolian spiced potatoes
items.mapQuery: Mahsan Turkish restaurant An Nada Riyadh

items.title: Ki
items.note: A dim Japanese restaurant in Al Narjis where phones go in a box and conversation cards come out.
items.read: Arab News (15 Nov 2026) says Ki has branches in Al-Narjis and Hittin. Guests lock their phones in a table box and play a We're Not Really Strangers-style card game over Japanese dishes such as rock shrimp, crispy chicken bao, wagyu beef gyoza and sushi, priced between SR49 and SR68. There is no reservation system; the reviewer waited about two hours on the Requeue app.
facts: Phone-free card-game dining, gyoza, bao, sushi
About two hours via Requeue (Arab News); no reservations

items.title: TDAY (تيداي)
items.note: An early-opening tea and croissant bakery café in Al Hamra, often praised for its quiet seating.
items.read: TDAY (تيداي) is listed as a café, bakery and coffee shop in Al Hamra, at Al Cheikh Hasan Ibn Hussein Ibn Ali. Reviews quoted on the Exa place listing praise its croissants (including double pecan, feta and pistachio), tea and karak, and the quiet seating, and put the rating at 4.6 from 568 reviews. It is listed as opening from 5:30 a.m. The brand's Linktree also points to branches in Al Taawun (Riverwalk) and Al Sulay.
facts: Al Cheikh Hasan Ibn Hussein Ibn Ali, Al Hamra 13217
Daily 5:30 a.m.–1 a.m. (to 1:30 a.m. Thursday and Friday, Exa listing)
items.mapQuery: TDAY تيداي cafe Al Hamra Riyadh

items.title: 74 Lounge & Specialty Coffee
items.note: A highly rated specialty-coffee lounge in Al Yasmin that stays quiet by day and fills up at night.
items.read: Caffe Atlas lists 74 Lounge & Specialty Coffee on Abdulaziz Bin Ayyaf in Al Yasmin, with a 4.7 rating from 951 reviews, outdoor seating, and a brunch tag. It is listed as a café and restaurant, open 8 a.m. to 1 a.m. (from 12:30 p.m. on Friday). An Exa listing of popular times shows mornings are usually quiet and evenings around 9–10 p.m. are the busiest.
facts: 8 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; Friday from 12:30 p.m.
items.mapQuery: 74 Lounge & Specialty Coffee Al Yasmin Riyadh

items.title: Chirpy
items.note: Gives every Slack channel, person or Mac app its own notification sound, so you can tell what pinged without looking.
items.read: Chirpy is a macOS 13+ menu-bar app that plays a different sound per Slack channel, contact, keyword or Mac app, using rules you set. The site says it is a 5.8 MB app that runs locally and does not read your messages or connect to Slack, Teams or Discord APIs, with 72+ built-in sounds or your own uploads. It is built by one independent developer in Barcelona. A three-day trial needs no credit card.
facts: $9.99 lifetime for up to 3 Macs (early Black Friday offer, listed as down from $19.99, through Cyber Monday)
Free 3-day trial, no credit card; 30-day money-back guarantee

items.title: Notally
items.note: A tiny, ad-free open-source Android notes app that keeps everything on the device.
items.read: Notally is a minimalist Android notes app with Material Design, rich text, labels, pins, reminders, widgets, image attachments, and export to PDF, text, JSON and HTML. The Google Play listing puts the APK at 1.2 MB, says there are no ads, trackers or analytics, and that notes stay on the device. It was updated 20 May 2026. The GitHub repo is GPL-3.0, has 2,214 stars, and lists v6.2 as the latest release (16 May 2026).

items.title: Bike Outliner
items.note: An unusually fast Mac outliner that stores files as plain HTML you can open in a browser.
items.read: Bike is a Mac outliner by Jesse Grosjean of Hog Bay Software. The site says it handles large projects that break other outliners, and offers row types, focus and typewriter modes, scripting and Shortcuts support. Its .bike format is HTML, and it also reads and writes OPML and plain text. A free mode with core features never expires; a paid licence unlocks extras such as rich text and row types. Bought from the developer's site it is a one-time licence for 3 Macs, with a year of updates and 50% off renewals (Hog Bay terms). Lifetime Mac reported the direct price as about $30 on 22 September 2026; the Mac App Store version is a subscription.
facts: About $30 one-time from the developer (Lifetime Mac, 22 Sep 2026); Mac App Store version is a subscription
Site licence includes a year of updates, then 50% off to renew; 3 Macs (Hog Bay terms)

items.title: Lunar
items.note: Controls the real hardware brightness, volume and input of external monitors from your Mac keyboard.
items.read: Lunar uses DDC to send brightness, volume and input-switch commands directly to external monitors, instead of dimming with a black overlay. The free tier covers keyboard brightness and volume control, input hotkeys and sub-zero dimming. Lunar Pro, listed at $23 on the official site, adds Sync Mode, XDR brightness, BlackOut, Clock Mode and more.
facts: DDC brightness, volume keys, input hotkeys, sub-zero dimming
Sync Mode, XDR brightness, BlackOut, Clock Mode
